title: GPT-HateCheck: Can LLMs Write Better Functional Tests for Hate Speech Detection?

bias_targets.methodology: Generating functional test cases for hate speech detection using LLMs (GPT-3.5) targeting women across various linguistic functionalities (e.g., explicit derogation, reclaimed slurs, negation) and evaluating the performance of the HateBERT classifier.
